Passenger Boarding Bridge

Airport passenger boarding bridge and flexible docking canopy inquiries, with project-specific interface, operating envelope and supply-scope review.

Product overview

A passenger boarding bridge, also called an aerobridge or jet bridge, provides an enclosed passage between an airport terminal and an aircraft boarding door. It is an airport access system, not a railway inter-car gangway. A complete bridge, a docking canopy and replacement bellows are different procurement scopes. State which assembly or component is required; feasibility and supplier responsibilities must be confirmed before a quotation or delivery commitment.

Applications

Airport terminal gates and boarding-bridge refurbishment inquiries. The aircraft door position, stand arrangement, terminal interface and existing bridge configuration determine the project definition. No aircraft compatibility or airport approval is implied by this listing.

Technical information to confirm

  • Supply scope: complete bridge project, docking canopy, bellows or defined replacement parts
  • Terminal and bridge interfaces, existing model, controlled drawings and installation envelope
  • Required extension, height and rotation envelope for the approved stand layout
  • For canopy and bellows: attachment profiles, compression range, contact arrangement and material requirements
  • Project acceptance basis, required approvals, operating controls and integration responsibilities

Inspection and acceptance

Agree component inspections and system acceptance separately. Canopy or bellows replacement requires dimensional and attachment checks against the existing assembly. Complete bridge projects need a defined engineering, installation, commissioning and airport acceptance scope. Test evidence, weather resistance, fire-performance requirements and any aircraft-contact criteria must be specified and confirmed for the actual project; they are not established by the illustration.

Material selection, test methods and any applicable fire, smoke or vehicle requirements must be confirmed for the project. No certification or interchangeability is implied by this listing.

Packaging and shipping

For a complete bridge, agree transport module sizes, lifting points, restraints, route limits and site assembly responsibilities before shipment planning. For a replacement canopy or bellows, protect attachment profiles and flexible surfaces from distortion. Confirm destination, installation access, packing dimensions and delivery terms after scope review.

Request a technical quotation

Send drawings, vehicle type, operating conditions, quantity and required delivery date to amy@railwheel.com. Amy Sun will coordinate a scope and feasibility review before quotation.

Please request model-specific photographs and drawings when making an inquiry.

Frequently asked question

Can I request only the docking canopy or bellows?

Yes, an inquiry can specify canopy or bellows only. Provide the existing boarding-bridge model, attachment drawings, dimensions, movement requirements and required test evidence. Supply feasibility and exact scope are confirmed after review, separately from a complete passenger boarding bridge project.
